title: Android Tags Index
problem: Android can open Tag related Media Items from known IDs but lacks a first-class server-backed Tags Index.
summary: Reuse the proven relationship index architecture to productize Tags Index as the second accepted index family.

evidence.notes: Focused tests cover NakoBrowseClient.listTags request construction, decoding, bearer auth redaction, and unsupported API version diagnostics.
Focused UI browse tests cover Tags relationship index route state, data-source mapping, save/restore, and row targets into existing Tag related Media Items routes.

Home exposes Tags as a nested relationship index route; NakoBrowseShell dispatches Tags through the shared route loader; focused host and relationship route tests passed, followed by the full Android debug unit gate.
profile-with-media smoke proves Home -> Tags -> Lighthouse -> Related Media Items and captures tag-index plus tag-index-facet evidence.

continue_policy.notes: Workstream closed on 2026-05-20. Open follow-on lanes for CI/device-farm smoke execution, golden screenshot diffing, or richer Tags IA such as sorting, clustering, and multi-select filters.
